text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I visited the infirmary
to have <chrname>'s physical condition checked——

Ah, yes-yeees! A custome—err, no,
a student!

Injuries? Illness? Or mental care?
Well, leave it aaall to me, no sweat!

Huh? Well, since I'm in the infirmary...
I guess that makes me a slightly fantastic school nurse?
...Or something like that?

Ahaha! Guess I couldn't fool you after all.
I'll just introduce myself normally, then.
*Ahem!* Truth be told, I am none other than—

Savior to countless Umamusume (probably)!
The (self-proclaimed) legendary acupuncturist with miracle hands!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And that name is Sasami Anshinzawa!!
Wooow, so re-assuuuring☆

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Master Acupuncturist.
Am I to understand you are a new practitioner on the academy's treatment staff...?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Woow, looks like you're not feelin' the relieee~f at aall☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, now, now, first things first!
Introductions are out of the way, so wanna take a little jab?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Wait.
Even within our clan, few are versed in bamboo acupuncture.
Undergoing it so lightly is――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! No need to be frightened, you know?
I'm just going to poke a few pressure points with my secret Sasabari needles!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And then, whoosh! You'll grow in leaps and bounds... surge with power...
Basically, something suuuuuper-duper incredible is gonna happen!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Just so you know, I'm not shady at all!
I've never failed even once!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...And Master?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Now, now, this is my very first gig, so broadly speaking, I've never actually failed before!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
After all, I spent ten whole years pouring tea...
I mean, training under a legendary master!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Woooow, relieee~f☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I couldn't possibly accept such an offer.
Taking <chrname> with me,
I moved to leave, but—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, wait, wait, hold on a second!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You're little Rose Kingdom, aren't you?
The earnest, stoic prince-type Umamusume
who marches relentlessly toward the Rose Clan's grand ambition!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course I know! I saw it!!
I'm a fan, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I came here to cheer you guys on!
To lend a helping hand, believe it or not!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So pleeeaaase!!
Just gimme a chaaance!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. The voices of those who support my clan...
Would dismissing them be a breach of faith?
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Pleeease, please, pleeease!
I'll even let you choose which pressure point I poke!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I prooooomise I won't fail, not eeeever~!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Probably.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah—well, it's basically an absolute certainty that's pretty close to a "maybe"? Or something like that?
...Well, don't sweat the small stuff!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, what kind of pressure point should we target?!
A stat boost, a health boost...
I've even got one for charm, you know!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It carries a terrifyingly dangerous scent, but...
there might... just might be a chance
it produces an incredible effect.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What should we do...?
choice_data_list: Aim for the pressure point that turns you into a strong Umamusume
Aim for the pressure point to win races.
Aim for the pressure point for health and vitality.
Aim for the pressure point that boosts charm.
I'm uneasy about this, so I'll pass.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, mm-hmm!
'The secret pressure point to become a strong Umamusume', gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm gonna jab it right in, okay? You ready?
...Are you reeeeaaaally, truly sure about this?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Okey-dokey, leave it to me!
Arise, bamboo needle! Reveal yourself, pressure point!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Now, just relax~... Wow, toootally reaa-ssuring☆!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: And in goes the needle!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The poke is a roaring success!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh.
To think the sasabari needles could be this potent...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
By all means, please allow me to introduce you to my clan next time.
I shall tell them that we have a truly magnificent acupuncturist.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, it succeeded? Seriously?! What?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No waaay!!
How did I even pull that off~?!?! 
I'm a total genius~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: <chrname> was overflowing with an unrecognizable surge of power!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems we've grasped the possibility.
I felt we had taken a massive stride toward our dream...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Guh...
It appears it did not agree with my constitution.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still... Lady Acupuncturist.
I appreciate your goodwill, truly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: <chrname> was visibly in poor condition...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Ahh~... Well, you know... right?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Woooow, buh-bye~☆

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, you there!
You're trespassing on academy grounds, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah?! Shoot, I've been spotted!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Woooow, time to scram~☆

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah!? H-Hold on a secoooond!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...In other words,
that acupuncturist was an intruder, then.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh. There are no shortcuts to our cherished ambition, it seems.
Let us press onward, taking each step firmly and surely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just who was Anshinzawa...?
Pondering it seemed pointless, so
I decided to forget everything that happened today.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, did you make a mistake?
Well, it happens, it totally happens all the time!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, tell me one more time!
Which pressure point are we aimin' for?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Talk about keeping me on edge~!?
Wait, but hang on, if we take this long—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa

You're trespassing on academy grounds, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...While I kept brooding over it, things somehow ended up left in the air.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What on earth was that about...?
Exchanging glances with <chrname>, I tilted my head in confusion.
